name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: In Ashenvale, Raene's Cleansing brings Dartol's Rod closer to being whole. Shael'dryn knows where its iron shaft lies, in a chest near the Felwood border. The search leads toward treants changed by corruption.

sections.title: A Fragment Near the Blight
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner sends you to Shael'dryn, a keeper who watches over a moonwell deep in Ashenvale. Shael'dryn knows where Dartol's Rod's iron shaft lies, but reaching it means facing the taint spreading through the northern woods. The shaft is locked in an old chest in a quiet glade near the Felwood border.

sections.title: The Fallen Guardians
sections.body: A wooden key is needed to open the chest, and Crazed and Withered Ancients hold it. These treants wander the mountain road north toward Felwood, their natural harmony shattered by corruption spreading south from the demonic wastes. Once guardians of the wild, they are now tormented and hostile, and the key lies with them.

faq.answer: Shael'dryn is a dryad at a secluded moonwell in Ashenvale, east of Astranaar and south of the Felwood road. She knows the forest's history and Dartol's ancient craft, and offers counsel to those trying to mend the rod.

Demonic taint from the Third War still spreads south from Felwood into Ashenvale. It warps the treants along the northern ridges, driving the ancient protectors mad and twisting their bond with the land.
Dartol's Rod is an enchanted relic made by Dartol, a now-dead evil wizard. Once assembled and purified, it can disguise its bearer as a furbolg, a power Raene needs to investigate the local tribes.

faq.q: Where is the hidden chest located?
faq.answer: The worn chest holding the iron shaft rests in a small, quiet glade just west of the mountain road that climbs north from Ashenvale toward Felwood.

faq.q: Why does Shael'dryn mourn the treants?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn mourns the treants because they are timeless caretakers of the Kaldorei forests, revered as sacred spirits of nature. Their madness and corruption have no known cure, so putting them down brings sorrow, not malice.

faq.q: How does this task fit into the wider cleansing chain?
faq.answer: Raene's Cleansing gathers the physical pieces of Dartol's broken rod. Once the iron shaft and other pieces are gathered, the work turns to purifying the rod's lingering magic.

angles.text: Putting down the Crazed Ancients is agonizing. These living trees were beloved companions and forest wardens before the demonic blight poisoned their spirits.
The ancients' madness, brought on by Felwood's encroaching taint, recalls the Emerald Dream's struggle to heal the wounded surface world.
Rebuilding Dartol's relic is essential to securing northern Ashenvale's roads against rising hostilities from corrupted furbolgs and demonic forces.
